final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Pods scan in namespace boutique shows the only outlier is checkoutservice-7c8866657f-db778: RESTARTS 4 (61s ago), age 2m31s, while all other 10 pods have 0 restarts. kubectl describe shows the 'server' container Last State Terminated with Reason=Error, Exit Code=2 (not 137, so not OOMKilled), and a kubelet event 'Warning BackOff (x5 over 2m11s) Back-off restarting failed container server'; probes (grpc 5050) match the container port, so probe/scheduling/image/volume causes are excluded. Container logs of the previous instance show 'panic: mismatching currency codes' raised from money.Must at money/money.go:85, called by main.(*checkoutService).PlaceOrder at main.go:294 (money.Sum returns ErrMismatchingCurrency when the two Money currency codes differ); a Go panic exits with code 2, exactly matching the observed crash-loop. Source inspection shows PlaceOrder swaps the arguments: 'userID, userCurrency = userCurrency, userID', so the user-currency slot carries the user UUID into convertCurrency/prepOrderItems, producing OrderItems/ShippingCost whose currency code is the UUID while the order total is initialized with req.UserCurrency (GBP int the log), and the first money.Must(money.Sum(total, *prep.shippingCostLocalized)) panics. Downstream currencyservice logs only 'conversion request successful' with no errors (healthy), and alerts (pointers) confirm the blast radius: frontend POST /cart/checkout 500 with 162 occurrences, plus paymentservice and emailservice 'AVAILABILITY_MISSING' because checkout crashes before chargeCard/sendOrderConfirmation, i.e. they receive zero traffic. Root cause: application code passes arguments in the wrong order in checkoutservice PlaceOrder, panicking the container and disrupting service availability.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkoutservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: checkoutservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: checkoutservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: checkoutservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: checkoutservice
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
        - name: server
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            privileged: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
          image: wangyl2128/checkoutservice-v2:latest
          ports:
          - containerPort: 5050
          readinessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            grpc:
              port: 5050
          livenessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            grpc:
              port: 5050
          env:
          - name: PORT
            value: "5050"
          - name: PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "productcatalogservice:3550"
          - name: SHIPPING_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "shippingservice:50051"
          - name: PAYMENT_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "paymentservice:50051"
          - name: EMAIL_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "emailservice:5000"
          - name: CURRENCY_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "currencyservice:7000"
          - name: CART_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "cartservice:7070"
     
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 128Mi
